title: Sharp threshold for prime-sum Hamiltonicity
plain: Keep each edge of the prime-sum graph with probability p. Find the threshold for a Hamiltonian cycle.
math: For random subgraphs of the prime-sum graph on $[2n]$ with edge probability $p$, prove the Hamiltonicity threshold is $p^*=(1+o(1))\frac{\log^2 n}{n}$ times an explicit constant, and determine it.
